name: kb_13_Normalized

schema.description: AllowedHostPath defines the host volume conditions that will be enabled by a policy for pods to use. It requires the path prefix to be defined. Deprecated: use AllowedHostPath from policy API Group instead.

pathPrefix.description:
pathPrefix is the path prefix that the host volume must match. It does not support `*`. Trailing slashes are trimmed when validating the path prefix with a host path.

Examples: `/foo` would allow `/foo`, `/foo/` and `/foo/bar` `/foo` would not allow `/food` or `/etc/foo`

readOnly.description: when set to true, will allow host volumes matching the pathPrefix only if all volume mounts are readOnly.

description: The policy permits pods to use host volumes whose paths begin with **/var/log**. Any volume mounted under this directory hierarchy will satisfy the allowed‑host‑path condition, and because the setting is not read‑only, the mounts may be used for both reading and writing.
